payload.rationale: The user explicitly selected TOML on September 10, 2026 for human-authored Projector configuration and canonical artifacts, while retaining JSON for useful machine or external contracts and SQLite for suitable derived state. Readability includes stable identity-derived filenames, deliberate ordering, multiline prose, local versioned editor schemas, and ordinary edits that do not require manual fingerprint repair. Semantic hashes compare normalized parsed values; exact bytes remain separately bound only where reviewed mutation, executable input, or recovery requires equality. This authority selects a format boundary, not correctness, acceptance, provenance, authorization, or universal editor support.
